The Wyoming knowledge test

Wyoming gives the knowledge test only in English. If you practice in another language, PermitVoice shows the English words under each question and answer, so you learn the words you will see on the test.

Practice questions

349 practice questions for Wyoming: 50 about Wyoming rules and 299 about signs, signals and markings that are the same in every state. Free: every question, hints and read-aloud. No sign-up.

Languages

  • Every question: English, Español.
  • The 299 national questions (signs, signals, road markings) also in 中文, Tiếng Việt, Tagalog, العربية. In these languages the Wyoming questions show in English for now.

5 sample questions

1. In Wyoming, what is the youngest age to get a learner's permit?

  1. 14 years old
  2. 15 years old (correct answer)
  3. 15 and a half years old
  4. 16 years old

Answer: B. In Wyoming you can get a learner's permit at 15 years old.

Wyoming handbook, page 7.

2. In Wyoming, what is the highest speed limit on interstate highways?

  1. 65 mph
  2. 70 mph
  3. 80 mph (correct answer)
  4. 90 mph

Answer: C. In Wyoming the highest interstate speed limit is 80 mph, and some interstate sections are 75 mph, so always obey the posted sign.

Wyoming handbook, page 41.

3. In Wyoming, a driver under 21 may not drive with a blood alcohol level of what amount or more?

  1. .05 percent
  2. .02 percent (correct answer)
  3. .08 percent
  4. .10 percent

Answer: B. In Wyoming a driver under 21 may not drive with a blood alcohol level of .02 percent or more.

Wyoming handbook, page 22.

4. In Wyoming, on a two-lane road posted at 45 mph or more, you pass a stopped emergency vehicle with its lights on. What must you do?

  1. Keep your speed and honk
  2. Slow to 20 mph below the posted limit (correct answer)
  3. Slow to 5 mph below the posted limit
  4. Stop and wait until it leaves

Answer: B. In Wyoming, on a two-lane road posted at 45 mph or more, you must slow to 20 mph below the posted limit when passing a stopped emergency vehicle.

Wyoming handbook, page 72.

5. In Wyoming, how long must you hold a learner's permit before you can get an intermediate permit?

  1. At least 10 days (correct answer)
  2. At least 6 months
  3. At least one year
  4. At least two years

Answer: A. In Wyoming you must hold your learner's permit for at least 10 days before you can get an intermediate permit.
